title: Data Engineer (f/m/d) x
description:
For our European Headquarters in Frankfurt am Main area (Offenbach) we are looking for an IT professional as a




Data Engineer (f/m/d)




who has hands-on experience in designing and developing data marts and databases to support analytical and business intelligence (BI) initiatives. This role will play a key part in building scalable data infrastructure that enables data-driven decision-making across the group. We offer a hybrid working model with regular collaboration days in Offenbach and remote work on the remaining weekdays.




Key Responsibilities:

 * Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and reliable data pipelines to ingest, transform, and load data from diverse sources (ERP, CRM, web/SNS platforms).
 * Integrating structured and unstructured data to create unified views for customer and sales analytics.
 * Building and optimizing ETL/ELT workflows using modern data pipeline frameworks for analytics and data warehousing.
 * Collaborating with data analysts, data stewards to understand requirements and deliver analytics-ready datasets.
 * Ensuring data quality, consistency, and compliance with data governance and privacy standards (e.g., GDPR).
 * Partnering with IT, marketing, and sales teams to align technical data workflows with business objectives.
 * Monitoring data flows, identifying anomalies, and proactively troubleshooting pipeline and infrastructure issues.




Requirements:

 * 3–5 years of experience in data engineering or a related technical role.
 * Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, engineering, or a related field.
 * Strong command of SQL and scripting in Python or Scala.
 * Hands-on experience with data pipeline orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, DBT, Talend).
 * Solid understanding of data warehousing and cloud-based analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery).
 * Familiarity with data modeling, performance tuning, and partitioning strategies.
 * Strong teamwork capabilities with experience working in cross-functional, multicultural environments.
 * Excellent English proficiency (both written and spoken) for effective collaboration with global teams and stakeholders.




Nice to have

 * Experience with Salesforce data architecture (objects, APIs, data models).
 * Understanding of SAP data integration, especially in automotive or sales domains.
 * Exposure to web/SNS data pipelines (clickstreams, user interaction, social media feeds).
 * Practical experience working with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
 * Familiarity with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).




Offer & Benefits:

 * Flexible working time and a hybrid work arrangement.
 * Work in an international team and versatile environment
 * Varied tasks with exciting and challenging IT projects
 * Function-specific, personal, and technology training
 * Attractive salary and excellent compensation and benefits package, including free lunch (as lunch vouchers or in the canteen), a free monthly ticket for public transportation and Gympass to support your wellbeing.
 * Relocation support




About us

Hyundai AutoEver Europe GmbH (HAEE) is a fully-owned subsidiary of the Hyundai & KIA Motor Group with its Headquarters in Seoul (South Korea). HAEE has its European Headquarters in Germany and affiliates in Slovakia and the Czech Republic.




We provide IT services that support the innovation and the IT competitiveness of the Hyundai and KIA Motors companies in various European countries, in areas like sales and manufacturing system development, implementation, and operation.
